title: When the Homecoming Falls
author: P. M. Joubert
blurb: Juniper Vasquez, the team's statistician who knows the game is rigged, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. But when the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does before the last game of the season.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
